question: Who among the following started the ceremony of ‘Sijda’ (prostration) and ‘Paibos’ (kissing of the monarch’s feet), in the court?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ghiyasuddin Balban**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ghiyasuddin Balban** was a prominent ruler of the Delhi Sultanate who reigned from 1266 to 1287.
 
• He is credited with the introduction of the ceremonies of **'Sijda' (prostration) and 'Paibos' (kissing of the monarch's feet)** in his court.
 
• These practices were instituted to reinforce the divine status of the Sultan and to ensure strict adherence to the royal protocol.
 
• Balban's emphasis on strict court etiquette and ceremonial practices was part of his broader strategy to consolidate his authority and assert his dominance over the nobility.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ghiyasuddin Balban was originally a slave before rising to power and becoming one of the most influential rulers of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• His reign is noted for the establishment of a centralized administrative structure and the enforcement of law and order.
 
• Balban's policies and reforms laid the groundwork for a more stable and efficient governance system in the Sultanate.
 
• He also took measures to suppress rebellions and maintain a strong military presence to deter external threats.
 
• Balban's legacy includes not only his administrative and military achievements but also his efforts to elevate the status and dignity of the Sultanate's monarchy.
